title: Barrier-free design requirements: when a relaxation is appropriate (current R1)
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 (National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: November 2025 (platform created November 20, 2025, last updated November 20, 2025)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies when a request for relaxation of barrier-free requirements is appropriate.
Division C 2.2.1.4 allows the Provincial Barrier-Free Administrator and Provincial Building Administrator to grant relaxation of one or more Section 3.8 requirements of Division B.
Barrier-free relaxations may be issued where compliance is unnecessary or extraordinary circumstances prevent conformance.
The applicant must demonstrate to the administrator that valid conditions exist to support a relaxation.

limitations: A published regulator interpretation of a documented design question, not an applicant file.
Case type is the nearest enum value; this is not an issued variance, appeal or worked example.
Relaxation under Division C; not an alternative solution. The March 2025 original (23-BCI-016) is superseded and kept as a reference.
